label: Ads & campaigns
intent: Persuade in one frame, then survive being cut into ten sizes.

recipes.goal: One square post that stops a scroll.
recipes.when: Feed placement. One idea, one subject, one line of copy.
recipes.text:
Create a {ratio} social media advertisement for {subject}.
IDEA — one clear proposition, expressed visually. Not a scene, not a story: a single idea that lands in under a second.
COMPOSITION — {composition} with a bold, simple silhouette and a deliberately empty zone for the copy.
BACKGROUND — {background} so the subject separates instantly from it.
LIGHTING — {lighting}. COLOUR — {grading}, saturated and confident.
MOOD — {mood}.
COPY — the exact text "{text}" in {type}, large, placed in the empty zone. Correctly spelled, no other lettering anywhere in the frame.
RENDER — designed graphic with hard edges and obvious hierarchy, built to be legible as a small square.

image.accepts: a product photo or a photo of a person
image.skeleton:
Use the supplied image as the exact reference for {subject}. Preserve its form, colour and any label text; if it is a person, preserve their identity.

Build a {ratio} social media advertisement around it: {composition} with a bold simple silhouette, {background}, {lighting}, {grading}, {mood}. Keep a deliberately empty zone for copy and set the exact text "{text}" in {type} there — large, correctly spelled, the only lettering in the frame. Hard edges, obvious hierarchy, legible as a small square.

negatives: no more than six words of copy
recipes.example: Create a 1:1 social media advertisement for a running shoe. IDEA — the shoe caught mid-stride against a black void, sole glowing, nothing else in frame. COMPOSITION — centred hero, the shoe large and angled, the lower third deliberately empty. BACKGROUND — flat near-black. LIGHTING — rim-lit on dark so the sole edge glows orange. COLOUR — rich saturated. MOOD — energetic. COPY — the exact text "RUN LATER" in bold geometric sans, huge, white, in the empty lower third; no other lettering. RENDER — designed graphic with hard edges and obvious hierarchy.

recipes.goal: The one image a whole campaign is built around.
recipes.when: The anchor asset. Everything else will be cut from this, so it must be strong and simple.
recipes.text:
Create a {ratio} campaign key visual for {subject}.
BIG IDEA — the image must express one clear attitude. Every element in the frame should be there because of that idea; remove anything that is merely decorative.
COMPOSITION — {composition}, with the subject given real presence and the frame left open enough that copy can be added later without crowding it. Keep a safe margin on all sides so the image survives being cropped to other ratios.
LIGHTING — {lighting}.
COLOUR — {grading}, restricted to a tight palette that reads as a deliberate brand choice.
MOOD — {mood}.
RENDER — {render}. High craft: believable materials, real shadows, no visible artefacts.
TYPE — the exact text "{text}" in {type}, held small and confident rather than shouted.

image.accepts: a product photo, a portrait, or a location photo
image.skeleton:
Use the supplied image as the exact reference for {subject}. Preserve what makes it recognisable — product form and colour, a person's identity, or the character of the place.

Build a {ratio} campaign key visual around it expressing one clear attitude. {composition} with real presence for the subject and open space for copy, plus a safe margin on all sides so it survives cropping. {lighting}, {grading} held to a tight palette, {mood}, {render} with believable materials and real shadows. Set the exact text "{text}" in {type}, small and confident.

negatives: no subject touching the frame edge
recipes.example: Create a 4:5 campaign key visual for a winter outerwear brand. BIG IDEA — one person standing still in weather that is trying to move them. COMPOSITION — rule of thirds, the figure on the right third, the storm filling the left two thirds, safe margin on all sides so it survives cropping. LIGHTING — one hard cold source from behind, the coat edge-lit. COLOUR — high-contrast cinematic, slate blue and bone only. MOOD — dramatic and resolute. RENDER — editorial photography with believable fabric and real shadows. TYPE — the exact text "STAND STILL" in condensed grotesque, small, lower left.

recipes.goal: The same ad in several formats at once, so a campaign ships consistently.
recipes.when: You need one creative across feed, story and banner without the set drifting apart.
recipes.text:
Create a single {ratio} image: an ad format set, showing the same advertisement in four shapes laid out in a row with even gaps on a neutral board.
SUBJECT — {subject}. The creative is identical in all four: same subject, same treatment, same colour, same copy. Only the proportions of the canvas change.
FORMATS — square, vertical, landscape and a tall banner. Reframe the same creative for each rather than redesigning it; the subject may be cropped differently but must never change size relative to the frame.
COPY — the exact text "{text}" in {type}, present and correctly spelled in every format, repositioned as needed so it never collides with the subject.
LIGHTING — {lighting}. COLOUR — {grading}. BACKGROUND — {background} within each ad.
RENDER — flat designed presentation, aligned baselines, no device frames, no perspective, no shadow on the board.
recipes.example: Create a single 16:9 image: an ad format set showing the same advertisement in four shapes laid out in a row with even gaps on a neutral grey board. SUBJECT — a can of sparkling water; same can, same rim light, same deep green background in all four. FORMATS — square, vertical story, landscape banner and tall skyscraper; the can is cropped differently in each but never changes size relative to its frame. COPY — the exact text "NOTHING ADDED" in bold geometric sans, correctly spelled and present in all four, repositioned so it never touches the can. LIGHTING — even flat studio light. COLOUR — rich saturated. RENDER — flat designed presentation, aligned baselines, no device frames.
